d: You've seen the videos of Jewar farmers turning into crorepatis overnight. Fancy cars, huge mansions, sudden wealth. It made all of us believe the system finally worked, that farmers got what they deserved. But that's not the full story. Yes, many got compensation. But behind the glamour lies a messier truth. Our ground report digs into what the viral videos never showed you, how farmers whose land built the Noida International Airport were paid less than they were promised, and how a lack of financial literacy has drained many of their accounts back to zero.
